Chhattisgarh Cooperative Department Approves 1,360 Recruitment

The Chhattisgarh Cooperative Department has approved direct recruitment for 1,360 positions. This decision is expected to open up employment opportunities for the state's youth. The recruitment will be for positions within cooperative banks. Minister Kedar Kashyap is associated with this initiative.
